name: @faker-js/faker 10.5.0 (bootstrap)
note: The bootstrap source, pinned exactly like every other one. It is fetched as an
immutable npm tarball into the gitignored cache, so faker-js is never in this
repository and no `npm install` is involved -- the package has zero runtime
dependencies, so node imports its ESM entry point straight out of the extracted
This is the lowest-precedence adapter. Every other adapter overrides it wherever
they overlap, so a field stops being faker-derived the moment something else covers
it, with no coordinating change anywhere. When coverage is complete the migration is
deleting adapters/faker-js.mjs and this file -- nothing else.
Its provenance is unaudited by construction: nothing in faker-js records where any
string came from. That is the reason for all of this, not an oversight to fix here.
